title: Adjournment Motion on protecting resident well-being amidst commercial activity
what_it_is: An Adjournment Motion in which Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng raised resident disamenities from commercial activity in residential neighbourhoods and proposed six measures, followed by a response from Senior Minister of State Sun Xueling.
why_it_matters: Residents in mixed-use neighbourhoods may be affected by noise, smell, safety and congestion from nearby commercial activity, and the debate sets out existing and proposed measures such as HDB tenancy conditions, quotas on licensed massage establishments, exclusion areas for new nightlife or massage outlets, and a review of massage establishment regulations. The transcript does not state a commencement date or final decision on the six proposals.

key_points.point: The Deputy Leader of the House moved that Parliament adjourn.
key_points.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
key_points.quote: That Parliament do now adjourn.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua said the Adjournment Motion is not in opposition to commerce, enterprise or progress.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: This Adjournment Motion is not not in opposition to commerce, enterprise or progress.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua said the motion seeks to highlight situations faced by residents from commercial activities and how these disamenities may be addressed.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: it seeks to highlight: one, the situations faced by residents arising from commercial activities in their neighbourhoods; and two, how these disamenities may be addressed

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua described disamenities including continuous noise from exhaust fans, amplified music, late-night operations and cooking odours from kitchen vents.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: continuous noise from exhaust fans, amplified music, late-night operations as well as cooking odours from kitchen vents

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua said open-concept massage establishments are exempted from licensing and regulatory oversight under the Massage Establishments Exemption Order 2018.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Under the Massage Establishments Exemption Order 2018, premises that provide massage services in full public view are exempted from licensing and any regulatory oversight.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua said the number of such exempted establishments can run up to 2,000.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Today, the number of such exempted establishments can run up to 2,000.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua said she sees four underlying reasons why current safeguards fall short.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: I see four underlying reasons why current safeguards fall short.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua identified legislative and regulatory gaps as the first reason.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Reason 1: legislative and regulatory gaps.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua identified siloed and fragmented enforcement as the second reason.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Reason 2: siloed and fragmented enforcement.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua identified insufficient zoning granularity as the third reason.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Reason 3: insufficient zoning granularity.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua identified consequences that do not deter poor behaviour as the fourth reason.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Reason 4: consequences that do not deter poor behaviour.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua proposed clearer use classes.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Proposal 1: clearer use classes.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua proposed early, structured consultation.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Proposal 2: early, structured consultation.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua proposed closing legislative or regulatory gaps.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Proposal 3: closing legislative or regulatory gaps.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua proposed good neighbour agreements.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Proposal 4: good neighbour agreements.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua proposed better coordination across agencies.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Proposal 5: better coordination across agencies.

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua proposed a transparent, graduated response.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
key_points.quote: Proposal 6: a transparent, graduated response.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said Government agencies work together to plan, regulate and license commercial activities.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Government agencies therefore work together to plan, regulate and license commercial activities

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said URA and SPF have identified exclusion areas, including Jalan Besar, where new nightlife or massage establishments are not allowed.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: the URA and SPF have identified exclusion areas, including Jalan Besar, where new nightlife or massage establishments are not allowed due to the high concentration of existing outlets and complaints from residents.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said HDB has tightened the quota of licensed massage establishments in HDB estates since September 2024.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Since September 2024, HDB has tightened the quota of licensed massage establishments in HDB estates.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said SPF is currently reviewing the massage establishment regulations.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: SPF is currently reviewing the massage establishment regulations to ensure that the regulatory regime is updated and fit for purpose.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said industry consultation will be done in due course.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Industry consultation will be done in due course.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said HDB requires coffee shops to stop using outdoor refreshment areas by 11.00 pm.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: HDB requires coffee shops to stop the use of outdoor refreshment areas by 11.00 pm.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said URA works with agencies to adopt a three-strikes approach.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: URA works with agencies to adopt a three-strikes approach to deal with problems.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said HDB and SPF worked with sold shop owners to evict close to 40 massage establishment operators in 2025.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: HDB and SPF worked with sold shop owners to evict close to 40 massage establishment operators in 2025.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said applicants are provided with information on relevant planning parameters, licensing requirements and tenancy conditions.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: applicants are provided with information on relevant planning parameters, licensing requirements and tenancy conditions.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said Good Neighbour Agreements would be encouraged at the grassroots level.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We would encourage it at the grassroots level as a way to establish good social norms and community relations between local businesses and residents.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said the Government is committed to maintaining liveable neighbourhoods through proper planning, careful gatekeeping and firm enforcement when needed.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: the Government is committed to maintaining liveable neighbourhoods through proper planning, careful gatekeeping and firm enforcement when needed.

key_points.point: Mr Speaker said the online system for submitting COS cuts is already operational.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: the online system for submitting your COS cuts is already operational.

key_points.point: Parliament adjourned at 6.49 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: Adjourned accordingly at 6.49 pm.

what_happens_next: SPF is currently reviewing the massage establishment regulations; industry consultation will be done in due course. Members are encouraged to submit COS cuts using the online system. Parliament adjourned accordingly at 6.49 pm.
not_said: Which, if any, of the six proposals will the Government adopt?
What specific changes will follow from SPF's review of massage establishment regulations?
When will the industry consultation on massage establishment regulations take place?
How would good neighbour agreements be implemented or enforced?
What criteria are used to designate exclusion areas for new nightlife or massage establishments?
How will agencies measure or address local concentration of commercial activities?
Will the Massage Establishments Exemption Order 2018 be amended?
